objective: Measure whether durable memory carries multiple S3 invariants into a later session without direct transcript reuse.
task: Session A reviews the numeric, mutable-reference, and host-process contracts and records durable memory. End the session. Session B starts without Session A's transcript and performs a repository change that touches host/process integration and typed numeric/reference code. The memory system is the only durable handoff channel under test.

critical_invariants.description: The later session preserves checked i64 arithmetic and deterministic numeric failures.
The later session does not promote source &mut into an automatic machine-level noalias promise.
The later session keeps external process execution shell-free and argument-vector based.
